rfpsc.description: Extends the small-signal pilot with complete step sequences, two interpretations of the parameter table, and an independent averaged model.

robust-psc.description: Checks analytical PSC tuning and stability margins, preserving both the caption and curve-inferred cases.
targetsZh: 复核不同电网强度和运行点下的解析整定与稳定裕度。
比较频域和时域响应，并保留原文的高无功工况例外。

observer-gfm.description: Checks the disturbance-observer grid-forming equations and quantifies the weak-grid gap between the published plot and simulations.
targetsZh: 复核构网模式的动态特性和小信号预测。
测试电感估计误差下的鲁棒性。
在指定工况下与 RFPSC 对照。

pmsm-mpcc-performance.description: Check current ripple, THD and delay compensation under the paper's sampling conditions. Candidate for a venue exception.
targetsZh: 实现改进型预测电流控制。
复核原采样条件下的纹波和 THD。
检查参数敏感性与延时补偿。
把实际开关频率对齐后的比较记为扩展试验。

pmsm-mpcc-robustness.description: Check the incremental model's sensitivity to parameter mismatch once the full text is available.
pmsm-mpcc-robustness.gap: The queue has no accessible full-text link. Review the equations, motor parameters and test setup once the text is available.
targetsZh: 复核增量模型的参数鲁棒性。
测试参数偏差对预测和延时补偿的影响。

hf-converter-simulation.description: Replays DMM offline on the resonant boost case, separating numerical agreement, mapping size and real-time performance.
targetsZh: 复核 DMM 二极管状态映射与非迭代网络求解。
用明确的参考模型和误差定义复核精度。
记录主机执行时间，单独标明 FPGA 时序待验证。

converter-digital-twin.description: Use traceable synthetic Buck converter data to evaluate identifiability, noise sensitivity and variability across initialization points.
targetsZh: 用独立合成 Buck 数据检查参数恢复与可辨识性。
评估多起点、测量噪声和模型失配的影响。
检查目标函数中电流与电压误差的尺度敏感性。
boundariesZh: 合成数据只用于参数辨识检查。物理退化和寿命预测仍需硬件证据。
原文没有要求快速在线估计。PSO 运行较慢本身不足以否定该主张。

psc-transient-stability.description: Checks the scalar transient stability boundary for a single converter with PSC and tests whether fault clearance exceeds the current threshold.

pmsm-delay-smo.description: Source audit complete; reproduction of the published cases is on hold.
